shared_elements: standing anthropomorphic figure, frontal or near-frontal torso
head with elaborate hair/headdress framing the face
patterned scale-like or textured surface covering the body
incised bands/lines across the torso and waist
raised arm/limb rendered against the body
justification: Both depict a single upright human-like figure with a large head, framing hair or headdress mass, and a body covered with incised patterning and horizontal banding at the waist, which is a broadly comparable but generic conception. A differs in showing a clearly articulated composite fish-cloaked figure in profile with raised bent arm, bracelets, kilt and a handled bucket-like object, while B shows a squat, blocky, frontal figure with a schematic disc/rosette and loop-like motifs on the chest and no legs or held attributes.
